safe_short_description: MUGE PACKAGING is a Shenzhen-based custom packaging source factory for brand owners, e-commerce sellers and international B2B buyers. The company supports custom paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, paper tubes, PVC/PET clear boxes and corrugated packaging, with packaging structure, material, printing and finishing options reviewed by project requirements.
